name: service-tc
description: Node application designed to run as a Windows service and call a web service daily.

scripts.service:install: npm run build && node dist/EntryPoint/windowsService.js install
scripts.service:start: npm run build && node dist/EntryPoint/windowsService.js start
scripts.service:stop: npm run build && node dist/EntryPoint/windowsService.js stop
scripts.service:restart: npm run build && node dist/EntryPoint/windowsService.js restart
scripts.service:uninstall: npm run build && node dist/EntryPoint/windowsService.js uninstall
